reviews.text: My dogs came out very happy and tired from playing
Excellent service and treatment of dogs 🐕 …

My little one stayed at our boarding facility and had an amazing time.

I was surprised by how happy he was when he arrived, especially since I hadn't let him out with many other dogs before. After leaving him at Dog Jancke, I discovered he's a very sociable little guy.

The experience was so positive that he'll be back soon, not because I'm away, but because I loved seeing him with so many friends. Highly recommended! 10/10 🌼🐶

Great dog hotel they watched over my dog Kobe for 1.5 months and attended to his needs while I was travelling. Definitely will recommend this dog hotel for anyone looking board there dog in Guadalajara
I left my pet there for over 6 days and she was absolutely delighted. I highly recommend it; they accept credit card payments.
A great place to leave your pet, excellent service from the staff! Maya 🐶 is a frequent customer. …
Excellent service, they take great care of your dogs and keep you well informed about everything ☺️
I left my pet there for 11 days and it came out with a stomach infection; it doesn't seem very clean, although the cost is acceptable.
Very bad experience, my puppy came back with fleas and sick, and in my opinion they don't have much experience in training.
